name: ShapedRecommend – Create Related Products, Upsells, Cross-Sells, and Product Recommendations for WooCommerce
author: ShapedPlugin LLC

sections.description:
ShapedRecommend is a complete WooCommerce product recommendations plugin that shows the right product at every step of the shopping journey — upsells, cross-sells, related products, Frequently Bought Together, bestsellers, on-sale and featured products — on your product, shop, category and cart pages.

Product recommendations are one of the simplest ways to increase average order value (AOV) in WooCommerce. Instead of the same fixed related products on every page, ShapedRecommend lets you decide exactly where a recommendation shows, which products it picks, how they are ranked, how the block looks and when it is allowed to appear — and preview it on desktop and mobile before it goes live.

Why ShapedRecommend?

  • One plugin for every recommendation type — related products, “You May Also Like”, upsells, cross-sells, Frequently Bought Together, “Customers Also Bought”, “Complete Your Order”, cart upsells, best sellers, popular products, featured products, on-sale products and more.
  • Never recommends what shoppers can’t buy. In-stock, on-sale and price filters keep sold-out or off-brand products out of every block.
  • Set it once, it adapts to every product. Each recommendation reads the product being viewed or the items in the cart, so one rule automatically shows relevant picks on every product page — no product-by-product setup.
  • Recommendation Manager — no repeated products, block limits and session limits so offers never stack.
  • Built-in analytics — views, clicks, conversions and revenue for every recommendation.
  • Fast and modern-store ready. Scripts load only where a recommendation shows. Compatible with HPOS and WooCommerce Cart & Checkout blocks.

Show On — Choose Where Recommendations Run

Show On sets the page type a recommendation belongs to. The recommendation always reasons from that page: the product being viewed, the category being browsed or the products in the cart.

  • Product — recommend anything that fits the product being viewed: similar items, premium alternatives, add-ons, items customers buy together or your own hand-picked products.
  • Category — showcase any mix of products on category and tag pages: popular, on-sale, featured, in-stock or your own curated picks.
  • Cart — suggest whatever completes the order: add-ons, accessories, better alternatives or best sellers that pair with what is already in the cart.

Start faster with ready-made recommendations — Related Products, Up-sells (You May Also Like), Cross-sells and Frequently Bought Together. Pick one and edit every field afterwards.

Position On Page — Place Recommendations Exactly Where They Convert

Drop each recommendation into the exact spot it converts, with no theme editing. Placements use native WooCommerce hooks, so they work with most themes.

  • Product page — before product tabs, after product tabs, after the product summary.
  • Category / tag archives — before products, after products.
  • Shop page — before products, after products.
  • Cart page — before the cart table, after cart totals, on the empty cart page.
  • Shortcode — [shapedrecommend id="…"] anywhere in posts, pages or widgets.

How Products Are Chosen — Rules

Set your own Rules — category, tags, price, stock and more — and ShapedRecommend automatically fetches the products that match them. Or pick products manually.

Filters — Control Exactly Which Products Appear

Narrow every recommendation with filters. Combine as many as you need.

  • Category and Tag — include or exclude.
  • On sale, In stock and Featured products.
  • Price — under, over or between two prices.
  • AND groups — every rule in a group must match.

Sorting — Rank the Best Products First

Sort rules decide which products appear first. Add more than one rule to break ties.

  • Frequently bought together strength.
  • Popularity — best sellers over a time window: 7, 14, 30 or 90 days, 6 or 12 months, or all time.
  • Price — low to high or high to low.

Pinned Products — Always Show Your Hero Items

Pin your own products to fixed positions — a new launch, a hero product or a high-margin item — and let the rules and sorting fill the rest of the block automatically.

Analytics — See the Revenue Each Recommendation Earns

  • KPI tiles — gross sales, net sales, items sold and orders.
  • Sales chart with comparison to the previous period.
  • Per-recommendation table — views, click-through rate, conversions and revenue.

Recommendation Manager — No Stacked or Repeated Offers

When several recommendations can show on the same page, the Recommendation Manager keeps your store clean and fast.

  • No repeated products — a product never appears in two blocks on one page.
  • Limit blocks per page and products per block.
  • Limit recommendations per session — avoid recommendation fatigue.

Display Styles & Device Targeting — Grid and List

  • Grid — product cards in rows.
  • List — compact rows, perfect for the cart.
  • Per-device columns — set columns for desktop, tablet and mobile separately.
  • Device display rule — turn on Display Conditions to show a recommendation only on desktop, tablet or mobile.

Perfect For

  • Fashion and apparel stores — “Complete the look” cross-sells and size-ready upsells.
  • Electronics and gadget stores — accessories, chargers and cases as Frequently Bought Together.
  • Beauty and cosmetics — routines and refills that customers buy together.
  • Grocery and food stores — basket fillers and best sellers in the cart.
  • Home, furniture and decor — matching items and premium alternatives.
  • Any WooCommerce store that wants a higher average order value without more ad spend.

Source code and build

The JavaScript and CSS under assets/build are compiled. Their human-readable source ships with the plugin in assets/src, together with the build tools: package.json, package-lock.json and webpack.config.js.

To rebuild the compiled files, run these from the plugin folder with Node.js 18 or newer:

  1. npm ci
  2. npm run build

The build uses @wordpress/scripts and writes the three bundles — the admin app, the storefront script and the editor block — to assets/build.
sections.installation:
Minimum requirements

  • WordPress 6.6 or later
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later

Automatic installation

  1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for ShapedRecommend.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open Recommend in the admin menu and click Create a Recommendation.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and upload the zip.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Open Recommend in the admin menu to create your first recommendation.
sections.faq:
Does it work with my theme?

Yes. Recommendations are placed on standard WooCommerce hooks, so they work with most WooCommerce-compatible themes. For any other spot, use the shortcode or the Gutenberg block.

Is Frequently Bought Together really free?

Yes. Frequently Bought Together recommendations and sorting are fully included. Show them as a Grid or List on the product page or in the cart.

Will product recommendations actually increase my sales?

Well-placed upsells, cross-sells and Frequently Bought Together suggestions help shoppers discover products they would otherwise miss, which raises average order value. The built-in analytics show the views, clicks, conversions and revenue of every recommendation so you can see the impact.

Do I have to replace WooCommerce’s built-in related products?

No. You can run ShapedRecommend alongside the default related products, upsells and cross-sells, or place your recommendations in the same slots.

Can I show recommendations on the cart page?

Yes. Place recommendations before the cart table, after cart totals or on the empty cart page.

How does the Recommendation Manager prevent too many offers?

It removes products that already appear in another block on the page and limits how many blocks show per page, how many products each block shows and how many recommendations a shopper sees per session.

Can I show a recommendation only on mobile?

Yes. Turn on Display Conditions and add a Device condition.

Can I place a recommendation anywhere?

Yes. Every recommendation has a shortcode, [shapedrecommend id="…"], and you can also add the “ShapedRecommend” block in the block editor.

Will it slow down my store?

Recommendations are resolved efficiently and scripts load only where a recommendation is shown.

What data does the plugin store? Is it GDPR friendly?

ShapedRecommend stores recommendation settings and anonymous view and click events on your own site to power analytics. It does not send store or customer data to third-party services. It integrates with the WordPress personal data export and erasure tools.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Your data is kept by default. If you want everything removed, turn on Clean-up Data on Deletion in Recommend → Settings → Advanced before deleting the plugin.
sections.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 – Oct 27, 2026

  • New: Custom date range in Analytics, within the last 30 days.
  • Improved: More accurate Frequently Bought Together — products no longer bought together stop being recommended.
  • Improved: Security and WordPress coding-standard updates.
  • Changed: A Frequently Bought Together sort on a Category recommendation is removed during the update; it had no effect on category pages.
  • Fixed: Clean-up on deletion now also removes the plugin’s cached data.
  • Fixed: A rare case where a shopper’s first clicks were not credited in Analytics.

Version 1.0.0 – Oct 13, 2026

  • Initial release.
